business_summary: Textron Inc. operates in the aircraft, defense, industrial, and finance businesses worldwide. It operates in six segments: Textron Aviation, Bell, Textron Systems, Industrial, Textron eAviation, and Finance. The Textron Aviation segment manufactures, sells, and services business jets, turboprop and piston engine aircraft, and military trainer and defense aircraft, as well as offers maintenance, inspection, and repair services; commercial parts; and advanced flight training devices. The Bell segment supplies military and commercial helicopters, tiltrotor aircraft, and related spare parts and services. The Textron Systems segment offers unmanned aircraft systems, electronic systems and solutions, advanced marine crafts, piston aircraft engines, live military air-to-air and air-to-ship training, weapons and related components, and armored and specialty vehicles. The Industrial segment offers blow-molded solutions, including conventional plastic fuel tanks and pressurized fuel tanks; plastic tanks for catalytic reduction systems and other fuel system components; lightweight and composite pentatonic battery systems for use in electric vehicles primarily to automobile original equipment manufacturers; and golf cars, off-road utility vehicles, powersports products, light transportation vehicles, aviation ground support equipment, professional turf-maintenance equipment, and turf-care vehicles to golf courses and resorts, government agencies and municipalities, consumers, outdoor enthusiasts, and commercial and industrial users. The Textron eAviation segment manufactures and sells light aircraft and gliders with electric and combustion engines; and provides other research and development initiatives related to sustainable aviation solutions. The Finance segment offers financing services to purchase new and pre-owned aviation aircraft and Bell helicopters. Textron Inc. was founded in 1923 and is headquartered in Providence, Rhode Island.
business_summary_ko: Textron Inc.는 전 세계적으로 항공기, 방위산업, 산업 및 금융 사업을 운영하고 있습니다. Textron Aviation, Bell, Textron Systems, Industrial, Textron eAviation 및 Finance의 6개 부문으로 운영됩니다. Textron Aviation 부문은 비즈니스 제트기, 터보프롭 및 피스톤 엔진 항공기, 군용 훈련기 및 방위 항공기를 제조, 판매 및 서비스할 뿐만 아니라 유지보수, 검사 및 수리 서비스도 제공합니다. 상업용 부품; 및 고급 비행 훈련 장치. Bell 부문은 군용 및 상업용 헬리콥터, 틸트로터 항공기, 관련 예비 부품 및 서비스를 공급합니다. Textron 시스템 부문은 무인 항공기 시스템, 전자 시스템 및 솔루션, 첨단 해양 공예, 피스톤 항공기 엔진, 실제 군사 공대공 및 공대함 훈련, 무기 및 관련 부품, 장갑차 및 특수 차량을 제공합니다. 산업 부문은 기존의 플라스틱 연료 탱크와 가압 연료 탱크를 포함한 블로우 성형 솔루션을 제공합니다. 촉매 환원 시스템 및 기타 연료 시스템 구성 요소용 플라스틱 탱크; 주로 자동차 원래 장비에 사용되는 전기 자동차에 사용되는 경량 복합 펜타토닉 배터리 시스템
